title: Training certificate — Espaço Prelúdio

intro.leadHtml: You registered as a professional without a regulated council (psychoanalysis, integrative therapy or hypnotherapy). To enable your public profile with the "team-verified" badge, we need your diploma or training certificate. Upload one of these:

list.i1Html: Training diploma issued by the institution (psychoanalysis school, hypnotherapy institute, etc.).
list.i2Html: Completion certificate from a training recognized in the field (e.g. SBH, ABRAP, Lacanian/Freudian trainings).
list.i3Html: Institutional declaration attesting that you completed the course (PDF signed by the coordinator).

differenceHtml: How this differs from regulated councils: your review is always manual — there's no automatic OCR because diplomas from free schools don't follow a standard. Our team reviews within 2 business days.

dropzone.title: Click to choose or drag the file here
dropzone.hint: PDF, PNG or JPG · up to 5 MB

review.leadHtml: Our team will review your diploma within 2 business days. You'll get the answer by email. Meanwhile, your account works normally — you can already see patients (consultation, chat, video, notes).
review.noteHtml: What doesn't work until approval: the public profile /verificado.html?u=... returns "not verified" (it does not show to patients clicking a public link).

verified.leadHtml: Your proof was approved by the team. The "Verified by team" badge appears on your public profile.
verified.note: Need to update your proof? Reach the team via the support button.

privacyHtml: Privacy: your diploma is stored encrypted, accessible only by the verification team. Automatically discarded 90 days after approval/rejection.

js.badFormat: Unsupported format. Send PDF, PNG or JPG.
